# FocusCheck

> Free online ADHD screening combining DSM-5 questionnaires (ASRS-v1.1, Conners') with cognitive performance tests for children, teens, and adults. Screening aid only — not a medical diagnosis.

FocusCheck is a web app that helps people self-screen for ADHD symptoms in 15–20 minutes. It pairs validated questionnaires with three short cognitive games (Continuous Performance Test, Stroop Color-Word Test, Working Memory N-back). Basic results are free; a detailed breakdown and clinician-ready PDF report are available as one-time paid upgrades. FocusCheck does not diagnose ADHD — a qualified clinician must do that.
